function.name: shc_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for SHC operations. Does NOT check soil reports or sample status. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated.

function.name: shc_register_soil_sample
function.description: Registers a new soil sample for testing linked to a specific land parcel. Transitions sample_status to 'registered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT collect or test the sample. Fails if land_parcel_id is invalid, a duplicate sample is already registered for the same parcel in the current cycle, or the farmer is not authenticated.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

gps_coordinates.description: GPS coordinates of the sample collection point.
